title: Chapter 39 The Major Inheritances Are Born
content:
Chapter 39 The Major Inheritances Are Born

The next moment, a shadow appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I thought you were not coming."

Hearing this, his face was a little embarrassed, and then his figure gradually solidified and turned into a middle-aged man in a white robe.

When Lu Daosheng just entered the long river of time and space, he felt it.

But he didn't dare to come out.

There was no way, he would never forget Lu Daosheng's terrifying aura.

That was a big boss in the realm of destiny.

But in the end, he still came out, because it was his responsibility to protect the long river of time and space. Lu Daosheng's move was a serious violation of the rules. According to the rules, he had to punish Lu Daosheng.

But there is a saying that goes, rules are dead, and people can also be dead.

If it is not handled well, he may be the one to die.

"Boss, do you have anything to do?"

At this time, the man in white robe spoke carefully.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, "I have something to ask you."

Immediately, the man in white robe hurriedly said: "I know everything!"

"I ask you, do you know the world of all spirits?"

The man in white robe nodded.

"Boss, outside this Hongmeng universe is the world of all spirits."

Seeing that he knew, Lu Daosheng continued: "You are the manager of this long river of time and space, so who sent you?"

This is what Lu Daosheng wanted to know.

Hearing this, the man in white robe hesitated.

"Boss, the long river of time and space has many branches. The long river of time and space that I manage is one of the countless branches of the long river of time and space, and it is also the lowest level. I don't know much, I only know that there is a huge force behind us, called the Palace of Time and Space."

Then he told how he was brought here by a senior from the Palace of Time and Space.

Since then, he has been responsible for guarding this long river of time and space.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng also nodded in realization.

It seems that there are still many things in the outside world that he doesn't know.

And he knows the Wanling Realm because the long river of time and space in the Wanling Realm is very close to this long river of time and space, so the two have communicated once, that's all.

"Wanling Realm, how much do you know?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

Hearing this, the white-robed man shook his head, "Senior, I haven't been there."

"Then can you call the manager of the long river of time and space in the Wanling Realm?"

Hearing this, the white-robed man looked bitter, "Boss, I don't have this authority."

In other words, his level is too low.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Obviously, he didn't get the information he wanted to know.

And seeing Lu Daosheng shaking his head, the white-robed man's face was a little pale.

This means that he is going to die.

Suddenly, the white-robed man knelt down hurriedly.

"Boss Tianming, please let me go for the sake of the Palace of Time and Space."

Looking at his expression that was about to cry, Lu Daosheng was a little speechless.

When did I say I was going to kill you?

Then, Lu Daosheng threw a crystal clear jade stone to the man in white robe, which was filled with pure space-time power.

"Protect the long river of time and space well."

After leaving this sentence, Lu Daosheng left the long river of time and space directly.

On the spot, the man in white robe looked at the stone in his hand, stunned for a long time, and then reacted.

"Thank you, big brother!!"

Back to the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng lay directly on the armchair and swayed leisurely.

This trip was not without gain.

At least I knew a lot about the Hongmeng Universe.

Especially the inheritance of the Xuan King.

In Lu Daosheng's opinion, the inheritance of the Xuan King must belong to Gu Chen.

I think that the inheritance will appear in the world soon.

Sure enough, at the boundary of the universe at this time.

The evil demon clan, like crazy, frantically tore the boundary barrier of the universe. On the border, the faces of the powerful people in the Hongmeng Universe were ugly.

At this moment, several terrifying auras suddenly surged from the border.

However, those auras did not have a trace of evil, but were full of familiar auras.

Everyone was shocked.

"Then, who are those?"

Boom!

Several illusory figures suddenly slowly emerged.

Seeing those figures, someone immediately exclaimed: "That, that is my ancestor!"

"Damn, that, isn't that my ancestor?"

"Those are the ancestors who fought against the evil demons back then!!"

At this time, someone exclaimed.

In an instant, everyone looked at those majestic figures with red eyes.

At this time, a figure with the most terrifying aura spoke.

He looked at the abyss coldly and said in a cold voice: "I knew that you, the evil demons, would not give up!"

"Haha, King Xuan, the Hongmeng world that you fought hard to defend back then, is now at the end of the road."

A gloomy voice sounded in the abyss.

Hearing this, King Xuan's face was heavy.

He was the strongest man in the Hongmeng Universe, Xuan Wang.

He was the leader of the eight kings of the Xuangu Galaxy.

In the war with the evil demons, he fought against the six evil kings alone. In the end, two of the six evil kings died and four were injured.

No one could match this record in the entire war.

And the price of Xuan Wang was his life.

At this time, Xuan Wang and others looked back at the border, the last remaining strong men in the Hongmeng Universe.

"Remember, I, the Hongmeng Universe, would rather die than surrender."

As soon as the voice fell, all the figures disappeared into the starry sky.

From then on, all of them became history.

On the border, Yang Lao and others were already in tears.

"Hongmeng Universe, I would rather die than surrender!"

"Hongmeng Universe, I would rather die than surrender!"

At the same time, in the major galaxies of the universe, one Taoist sect after another suddenly rose from the ground, shocking the heavens.

Without exception, they were all the inheritances left by the ancestors.

The Xuan Gu galaxy had the most, with a total of eight Taoist sects.

At the border of the universe, on the border, Yang Lao felt the strangeness in the universe and then understood it.

"Go, go quickly and come back quickly."

"Yes, Yang Lao."

Then, several people hurried back to their respective galaxies.

They also wanted to fight for those inheritances, not to mention that some of them were the inheritances of their ancestors, and the fat water should not flow to outsiders.

.........

Xuan Gu galaxy, in the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng released Gu Chen, who was passionately breaking through in the world in his palm.

Suddenly, Gu Chen was stunned.

"City, Lord City Lord, the time is not up yet."

It can be seen that Gu Chen was a little reluctant.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Now, there is a great opportunity waiting for you. That opportunity is destined for you."

Then, Lu Daosheng told Gu Chen about the inheritance of Xuan Wang.

At first, Gu Chen didn't care.

Until Lu Daosheng said that the other party was once the strongest in the Hongmeng Universe, and fought against the evil demon clan and fought against six people alone, Gu Chen suddenly had a look of respect.

Xuan Wang, it turned out to be such a person.

"What do you think? Do you want to go?"

Lu Daosheng looked at Gu Chen and smiled.

"Go! Thank you, Lord City Lord!"

Hearing this, Gu Chen immediately agreed.

That is the inheritance of Xuan Wang. If he doesn't go, he will be a fool.

Then Lu Daosheng nodded.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng grabbed Gu Chen, broke a crack in time and space, and threw Gu Chen in.

"If you are lucky enough to meet King Xuan, tell him for me that the Hongmeng Universe will no longer be in any danger."

"Yes! Lord City Lord!"

The last voice was infinitely stretched.

And Gu Chen also successfully entered the Dao of King Xuan.

At the same time, countless practitioners in the Tianxuan World were shocked by the sudden appearance of the Dao.

Practitioners from all over the world began to rush to the Evil God Abyss.

Of course, the Evil God Abyss there no longer exists.

"The inheritance of King Xuan? Who is King Xuan?"

When they learned the meaning of this Dao, everyone looked puzzled.

As for the identity of King Xuan, no one could tell.

When Lu Daosheng in the deserted city learned about this, his face suddenly dimmed.

The king of the Xuan Gu Galaxy, the strongest in the Hongmeng Universe, and the pride of the Tianxuan World, has now reached a point where no one knows.

That's a real hero.

Then, Lu Daosheng flew into the void and told the story of Xuan Wang in person.

Suddenly, the sound of the Tao resounded throughout the Tianxuan world, and even outside the Tianxuan world, Lu Daosheng's voice could be heard.

Soon after, everyone was shocked, and some people were already in tears.

Everyone looked back at the Xuan Wang Daotong, and immediately felt an infinite respect.

"It turns out that my Tianxuan world was so glorious, and there was a peerless figure like Xuan Wang."

"Xuan Wang, a role model for our generation!"

"I want to inherit Xuan Wang's inheritance and repel the evil demon clan!"

"Haha, I'm embarrassed to point it out to you."

After some people learned about Xuan Wang's strength, they immediately rushed to Xuan Wang Daotong without stopping.

For a figure like Xuan Wang, how good is his inheritance?

It's enough for him to soar to the sky.

With this idea, more and more practitioners rushed to Xuan Wang Daotong.

However, they didn't know that someone had already reserved the inheritance in advance.

Fortunately, there were countless opportunities in the Xuanwang Dao Sect, and it was enough to pick up any treasure with good luck.
